system.description: Once per encounter, while making a Charge, you take no cumulative penalty to Use the Force checks for each Block attempt you make during the Charge. When performing Slashing Charge, you can apply the attack bonus granted by the Charge to all Riposte attacks as well. You can declare the use of this ability after you begin the Charge, but must do so before you make your first Riposte attack.

prerequisite.text: Dueling Stance talent, and Redirection Stance talent, and Weapon Focus (Lightsabers)
